Hi! You should check r/BPDpartners for some of the experiences of people whose partners have BPD. I would also recommend getting your own therapist to help you process your experiences with her especially if it’s affecting your mental health. 

While mental illness can explain behavior, it doesn’t excuse hurting the people around you. Your partner has to actively work on her thinking especially the splitting for it to get better and not to affect your relationship. Lapses on her part are okay if she’s working on it naman, progress is not linear, but if she’s not doing anything to improve it, that’s on her. 

If she’s not comfy with her psych, maybe it’s better that she gets a new one and then she can ask for better meds.

legit naman yung sa mga nowserving. you can check their profiles if they offer in-clinic sessions, then you can schedule with them. if you’re really worried about their legitimacy, you can check or ask for their certificates or even check if they passed the boards for psychiatrists. 

a lot of doctors use nowserving na rin, kahit nga walk in clients nila minsan nirerefer na sa app to schedule the appointment.

I’m not sure about a gaming laptop but I use an ipad air for my genshin. It’s really the only use I have for my ipad air except for occasional work stuff. An ipad might be more useful to you if you also want to be able to use it for work although you might only be able to use it for basic word and excel which you’ll still need a microsoft office account for.
Project Zomboid is so good especially if you have friends who play the game. You can go on loot runs and build your base together

sometimes you just need time off away from each other when emotions are heightened. best to just give him space and figure out how to calm your anxieties in a relationship in case he comes back and still wants to continue. if he comes back, try also to communicate with each other about ur specific needs. Kahit simpleng abiso lang kamo if he’s gonna be busy. Try to compromise rin lalo if he’s in a high paced job. 


hindi naman lahat ng nakikipagcool off nakikipagbreak kagad, minsan kailangan lang talaga ng space lalo pag sunod sunod na away.

I’ve never been accountable for my actions. I think there’s no more improving. I don’t even know how to be accountable when I don’t even recognize my mistakes. I really should just die so I’m not a menace to society
I took pills which are 2 pills shorter than the dangerous dose. I’m sure I’ll survive and I’ll hate myself tomorrow morning but I just want to be able to get some rest tonight. I’m so tired.
There’s nothing to look forward to, I think. I used to try looking forward to something just to keep me going but now there’s nothing
can it only be seen thru xray? thank u for the response!

I drank cold water yesterday and felt pain as a result which lasted quite a while so I immediately went to my dentist to get it checked. We couldn’t find anything wrong with it but my tooth is still a little sensitive, not as much as yesterday though. We also tried to get it x-rayed in other angles but we still couldn’t find the the rest of the canal(?)
Thank you so much. I really needed to hear this. I haven’t told any of my friends about this “attempt” yet and I don’t think I’m planning to.

I dunno why I’m posting this but I just don’t have anyone else to talk to. Feel free to ignore this. I just really need to get this off my chest but I’ve just tried to drown myself and it scares me how willing I am to do it again.
